title: Aurora Design System
description: A token-driven, theme-aware design system for product teams. Aurora encodes every color, spacing, and motion decision as a semantic token, so re-theming an entire product takes minutes. It ships with 60+ accessible React components and a living documentation site with Figma sync. The system uses zero-runtime CSS and supports fluid typography across all viewport sizes.

title: Lumen Analytics
description: Privacy-first product analytics with edge ingestion. Lumen ingests millions of events per day at the edge with sub-50ms p99 latency. It features a query builder, cohort retention analysis, and a zero-cookie architecture that keeps user data on-device. The platform is built on Cloudflare Workers with ClickHouse as the storage layer.

title: Harbor CMS
description: A headless CMS that feels like a notebook. Harbor reimagines content management as a calm, block-based editor with real-time collaboration. Built on CRDTs (Yjs), it works offline-first and syncs instantly across devices. The editor supports custom block types and a plugin architecture for extending the writing experience.

title: Driftwood CLI
description: Ship full-stack apps from a single command. Driftwood is a zero-config scaffolding CLI that generates production-ready Next.js apps with auth, billing, and CI pre-wired. It ships with 12 opinionated templates covering SaaS, e-commerce, and content platforms. The CLI includes a project generator with interactive prompts and intelligent defaults.

title: Prism Motion
description: Declarative scroll-driven animations for React. Prism Motion is a lightweight animation library focused on scroll storytelling. It composes framer-motion primitives into a declarative API with a 3kb runtime. The library includes scroll-triggered reveals, sticky elements, and progress-linked animations — all type-safe and tree-shakeable.
